test_title: PYST 14: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct option for the Direct Speech conversion:

He observed that, had market liquidity vanished entirely, the exchange would have suspended trading.

options.text: He said, “If market liquidity vanishes, the exchange suspends trading.”
He said, “Had market liquidity vanished entirely, the exchange would have suspended trading.”
He said, “The exchange will suspend trading if liquidity vanished.”
He said, “Liquidity vanished so trading stopped.”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
